text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone.
I believe you have already heard, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's review the fan vote results for this year's Takarazuka Kinen once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And the glorious 1st place goes to—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's Kitasan Black. Congratulations.
Deliver your best race on the main stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final results of the Takarazuka Kinen fan vote
were announced... and Tracen Academy erupted with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
We really did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's all thanks to you, Trainer!
Because you trained me so thoroughly and patiently...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Back when nobody paid attention to me...
To think that now, so many... so many people are cheering for me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the support of her fans pushing her forward,
Kitasan Black finally heads into the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you, Brusquemente-san!

text_block_list.name: Brusqueman
text_block_list.text: ……yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That trembling from last spring is coming back...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer. I feel like if I run right now, I might finally understand the things I couldn't before.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just what makes Brusquena so strong,
and to what extent? And compared to her, where do I stand...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Things I've caught up with, and things I haven't.
And for the things I haven't, I must put in the effort to catch up from now on...
choice_data_list: Let's also figure out "what's not worth chasing after."
Let's also figure out "what's not worth chasing after," okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Something... you don't need to pursue?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I advise Kitasan Black. Every Umamusume has her own individuality—no one can have it all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to chase after what makes Brusqueman unique.
Kitasan Black must ultimately master her own path.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—You are wise. That is precisely correct.
Every Umamusume has an origin,
and it is crucial to examine it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You must come to deeply understand us—and the true meaning of the bloodline we inherit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The meaning of blood...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, maximize one's own bloodline. The perfected form
and unique glory exist nowhere else.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So today, show me, Kitasan Black.
—Show me the meaning of your bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To see just how much potential she harbors
within the crucible of competition against Brusqueman.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their first confrontation after entering the Senior Year.
Today, for the first time, the two of them learn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Who the rival she had honed herself against as a classmate—truly was.
